mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t_system_role_menu.menu_id FROM t_system_user_role LEFT JOIN t_system_role_menu ON t_system_user_role.role_id = t_system_role_menu.role_id WHERE t_system_user_role.user_id = ( SELECT t_system_user.id FROM t_system_user WHERE t_system_user.is_deleted = 0 AND t_system_user.user_name = #{userName} )

SELECT DISTINCT t_system_menu.menu_purview FROM t_system_user LEFT JOIN t_system_user_role ON t_system_user.id = t_system_user_role.user_id LEFT JOIN t_system_role_menu ON t_system_user_role.role_id = t_system_role_menu.role_id LEFT JOIN t_system_menu ON t_system_role_menu.menu_id = t_system_menu.id WHERE t_system_menu.is_deleted = 0 AND t_system_menu.menu_type IN (2, 3) AND t_system_user.user_name = #{userName}
